profile.summary: Prior purchases emphasize comfort, weather, material, durability; ratings are usually positive.

messages: not totally sure what i want yet tbh, just browsing. leggings for women maybe? something i could wear to the gym and also just around.
something soft and stretchy - 4-way stretch, spandex-y. my last pair was mostly polyester with some spandex and they were great, squat proof and not see through.
pockets, that's the big one. a proper side pocket that fits my phone and ideally a little hidden one in the waistband for keys. high waisted with tummy control too.
hmm. maroon? or honestly anything dark. i had a maroon capri pair once and loved the colour, but i'm flexible.
capri length, cropped just below the knee. i find full-length ones too hot in summer.
depends on the brand honestly. usually an XX-Large in this kind of thing, but sizing is all over the place so i'd want a size chart.
cycling and running mostly, plus a yoga class on wednesdays. and then lounging around the house, which is probably 80% of it if i'm honest.
nothing crazy - twenty to twenty five dollars is about right. i'm not paying lululemon money for something i mostly wear on the sofa.
honestly i don't have any extra preference on brand - whatever fits the budget is fine by me.
ok if you're pushing me - IUGA. a friend has their capri leggings and swears by them.
